title: USC scientists discover how to create a never-ending supply of cancer-fighting cells
caption:
Current cellular immunotherapies often struggle because mature defender cells burn out quickly. By culturing and genetically altering immature precursor cells, researchers established an ongoing biological supply that slowed tumors in mice.

Source: Sciencedaily - USC scientists discover how to create a never-ending supply of cancer-fighting cells
